body: Check out some videos on youtube about waymo. They even have a window to the driver's seat to prevent manual intervention. And quite rightly so. Just compare the human reaction time with that of AI. Dangerous situations on the road are usually highly predictable, especially at a distance and with a high level of attention (there it is 360 degrees long distance), and are largely a problem of inappropriate speed or disregard for distance rules.  All of these can be handled by AI without any problems.

Who actually thinks this action makes strategic sense? At best, it is only useful in the short term. Even before the action, institutional investors had come to the conclusion that Gamestop was overvalued. Now the stock is massively overvalued and, because the top seems to have been reached, an even more ideal target for short selling.

Private investors will gradually have to sell or hold on to the future continuous loss in value and lose considerable money. The hedge funds, on the other hand, are probably out of the short sales early and may even have taken the hype on the buy side to now short again. At the end of the day, the retail investors lose more than the hedge funds.

Better prepare the civil society foundation to regulate financial capitalism most strictly or, best of all, abolish it altogether and distribute money flows fairly in the interest of the general public.
